    SKY price on each exchange

    About Sky (formerly Maker)

    Sky is the rebranded MakerDAO ecosystem, issuer of the USDS and DAI stablecoins. MKR holders can upgrade to SKY at a rate of 1 MKR = 24,000 SKY, which is used for governance and rewards.

    Where this SKY price comes from

    The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (SKY-USD), Binance (SKY/USDT) and Kraken (SKY/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 23.42B SKY (supply last updated November 2, 2026).
